original_failure.site: CanonicalIntentReader.read initial intent query before work reservation/admission
original_failure.statement: No original phase-level timings were retained; reproduction establishes a sufficient matching failure mechanism, not retrospective observation of the exact original scheduling interval.

query_plan: SEARCH execution_client_intents USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_execution_client_intents_1 (server_id=? AND actor_agent_id=? AND client_intent_id=?)
demonstrated_mechanism.conclusion: The 40ms whole-open budget starts before connection creation. Each new connection reloads/compiles the full schema. sqlite3_prepare_v2 itself reaches progress deadline and returns SQLITE_INTERRUPT(9), before sqlite3_step is invoked. Empty indexed intent lookup is not the expensive phase.
demonstrated_mechanism.warm_observation: Reused connection schema cache reduces native prepare to minimum0.0184ms; prewarmed new connection target prepare0.0696–0.0921ms and step at most0.065ms in the measured sample.
demonstrated_mechanism.cold_definition: Connection/schema-cache cold only; OS file cache was not purged and file hashing reads database pages.

instrumentation_note: Initial C API probe omitted sqlite3_initialize and failed with an access violation before opening a DB; corrected explicit initialization produced the retained measurements. This is a probe defect, not a product finding.

minimal_candidate_plan.initial_budget_basis: Explicit one-time initialization budget, not a larger recurring query timeout. Observed first cold total41.1–41.5ms and schema preparation<=32.4ms;100ms bounds initialization while leaving room within the unchanged1s owner cadence. OS scheduling/filesystem stalls remain fail-closed and cannot be given a hard OS deadline.
minimal_candidate_plan.api: ReadOnly.prepare(path) caches one owner-thread, mode=ro/query_only connection per identity. ReadOnly.open(path) creates BEGIN snapshot for this read and always ROLLBACKs it; close() releases all cached handles. Canonical readers prepare before admission. A newly created Core journal initializes once on first existence during owner polling.
minimal_candidate_plan.freshness: Validate safe path and stat identity on each read; maintain fresh transaction per tick; verify schema version has not changed or fail closed rather than silently recompiling an unexpected schema.
minimal_candidate_plan.failure: No transparent re-open or retry after timeout, replacement, schema drift or unexpected close. Preserve primary error metadata and uncertainty. Keep global controller/token authority and120s/1s/200000 rules unchanged.
minimal_candidate_plan.qualification: Own closed real161-table DB cold/warm comparison; synthetic fresh-snapshot mutation, DB replacement, initialization/read timeout, explicit close/owner checks, actual Core late journal arrival, global ledger/worker composition regression.
